title: Telia Estonia trials Adtran 50G PON technology to prepare for next-generation broadband services
summary: Adtran today announced that Telia Estonia, part of Nordic and Baltic telecommunications operator Telia Company, is trialing its 50G PON technology as the next step in the evolution of its fiber broadband infrastructure.
body_markdown:
News summary:


- Telia Estonia is preparing its fiber network to support the next generation of residential and business broadband services
- Trial of Adtran’s 50G PON solution establishes a practical path to higher-capacity access over existing infrastructure
- Project will validate how 50G PON can operate alongside GPON and XGS-PON services, enabling phased network upgrades


Adtran today announced that Telia Estonia, part of Nordic and Baltic telecommunications operator Telia Company, is trialing its 50G PON technology as the next step in the evolution of its fiber broadband infrastructure. Building on its deployment of Adtran’s fiber access platform, the proof of concept (PoC) will evaluate how 50G PON can coexist with existing GPON and XGS-PON services on a common network infrastructure. The trial will help Telia Estonia prepare for future residential and business connectivity requirements while providing a practical framework for introducing higher-capacity services as market needs develop.
